items.title: 66600_Teddy Wilson oral history interview
items.q: starting out with Nat Cole and Oscar Peterson later and then Ella and Flip Phillips, Jo Jones, Gene Krupa

ctx.x: Those little troops with Dizzy and Roy and starting out with Nat Cole and Oscar Peterson later and then Ella and Flip Phillips, Jo Jones, Gene Krupa
and Buddy Rich. Ray Brown. That carried the banner of jazz all over the world. They made a tremendous [impression], in Europe and Japan.
